purpose: Determine whether NOAA/NCEI GOES-16 operational SGPS L1b can be mapped deterministically to the public SWPC differential-proton live interface without using event labels, forecast scores, or protected outcomes.
anchor_selection_rule: Within each frozen month, choose the lexicographically first NetCDF file in the operational seis-l1b-sgps directory. Do not inspect labels or model scores to choose a day.
required_historical_semantics: a proton differential-flux variable or variables
thirteen documented differential proton energy channels spanning approximately 1-500 MeV
energy lower/upper/effective metadata sufficient to bind channels without guessing
forbidden_actions: manual channel mapping after seeing model performance
if_binding_fails: Reject L1b as the historical source for the live-compatible causal model. Preserve the negative result and move only to a separately named development study whose historical reprocessing limitation is explicit.
claim_boundary: A pass establishes source-schema binding only; it does not establish forecast skill, historical operational replay, or independent validation.
